Name change /father update
I recently had a change on my birth certificate that started to show my father’s name + a new surname and I’m wondering how this can affect my partnership process? I did not updated my documents yet so MH wasn’t notified and there’s no way that they will know this change if I don’t change my passport, they would only see it in case of an official document from my HC is requested. 

I’m not looking to be “double person” I’m just not interested in making my process complicated. I have 3 more years until applying for citizenship and there’s no date showing when the change/addition happened. 

Any insight would be appreciated.
